name: List integrations
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the collection of integrations available for a specific UI location, such as the contact details view. Use a more specific action that retrieves details for a single integration if you need information about just one integration rather than the full list.

location.description: The UI location for which integrations should be listed (e.g., "contactDetails").

data.description: Array of integration objects (structure not defined in observed data).

totalCount.description: Total number of integrations available for the given location.

itemCount.description: Number of integrations returned in this response page.
